title: ak setup verify --json (setup-verify-v1)
description: A closed list of named checks about a kit setup, each with a verdict and the one command that repairs it. Read-only: verify never applies a repair. Never contains a secret value. Consumers check `schema` and `interface` first.

ok.description: true when no check is `fail` (a `warn` never fails).

repair.description: The exact command that repairs this check, or null when only the person can act (for example a login).
